tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnam sras kyi gtor bsngo bsdus pa bzhugs so// rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drangs/ oṃ bai shra wa na sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ a kā ro gsum sogs kyis gtor ma phul/ mchod pas mchod/ rgyal po chen po 'khor bcas/ sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ bskang gso bsdus pa tsam byed na/ bskang rdzas sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs la/ bstan srung chen po/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i rnam sras gtor bsngo/ sogs bya/ rjes/ bdag bskyed gang byas spyi 'gros sbyar ro/ /zhes pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so/ /maṅga laṃ/ zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rnam sras kyi gtor bsngo bsdus pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
